sentences.text: Siobhan Kelly is the district nurse who has been seeing Keith Dawson for leg ulcers.
Keith Dawson has leg ulcers on both legs that are slow to heal.
Keith Dawson's GP is Dr Morgan at Holloway surgery.
Keith Dawson has not seen his wife since 2015.
Keith Dawson's brother Phil lives in Northby and they only communicate at Christmas.
Keith Dawson receives Employment and Support Allowance (ESA) and is waiting for a pension to start next year.
Keith Dawson believes he is up to date with his bills, though the gas is on a meter.
Keith Dawson has not had heating since October.
Keith Dawson has not had hot water since October.
Keith Dawson has been using a fan heater but finds it expensive and does not use it regularly.
Keith Dawson has not washed in three to four weeks.
Keith Dawson has not cooked meals for himself due to the absence of hot water and the presence of rats in the kitchen.
Keith Dawson has seen two rats in the kitchen, which have been feeding on bread, and has stopped using the kitchen for food storage.
Keith Dawson has not had meals for four days last week due to missed home care visits.
The home care agency Bright Days was supposed to provide morning and teatime visits.
In the last two weeks, Bright Days missed 16 out of 28 scheduled visits, with no record of visits for 16 days.
For four consecutive days last week, no one from Bright Days came to visit Keith Dawson.
Keith Dawson did not contact Bright Days when visits were missed, stating he did not want to bother them.
Keith Dawson's primary wish is for the heating to be fixed and the rats to be removed.
Keith Dawson stated he does not want a home or any form of relocation.
The neighbour at number 25 reported to the district nurse that Keith Dawson has been drinking heavily.
The district nurse Siobhan Kelly did not personally observe any signs of Keith Dawson drinking heavily.
Keith Dawson denies the claim about heavy drinking and calls the neighbour a 'nosy cow'.
The social worker Rachel Burns will raise a safeguarding concern about the missed care visits and the poor condition of the home.
Keith Dawson agrees to a safeguarding concern being raised if the boiler is fixed.
The district nurse will continue to visit Keith Dawson on Tuesdays and Fridays for leg ulcer care.
The social worker will contact the housing association to log the boiler as an emergency repair.
The social worker will request two oil heaters to be delivered to the home within the next 24 hours.
The social worker will contact environmental health to arrange pest control in the kitchen.
The social worker will raise the issue of missed visits with Bright Days and the commissioning team.
